terminology.note: Distinguished key agreement from key transport/encryption, shared value from derived traffic keys, authentication from public value validation, subgroup generator from primitive root, DLP from CDH, private exponent from full RSA key, integer representatives from bytes, modulus length from base-point order and serialized key size, point doubling from general scalar multiplication, finite field from real geometry, and classical security estimates from successful factoring records.

mathematics.note: Matched all nine display formulas exactly and checked relevant inline assumptions. DH uses prime subgroup order and nonzero uniform secret exponents; Euler proof retains coprimality and all representatives use primewise zero/nonzero cases and CRT. ECC uses p>3, nonsingularity modulo p, infinity/identity/inverse and y=0 exceptions. Independent fixtures verify100DH pairs, active MITM values13/18,143RSA representatives including23noncoprime,286primewise cases, the e1 flaw,20curve points/400pairs/8000associativity triples/3zero-y doublings and a singular field counterexample. Finite checks are not security proofs.
